WISH-1.name: NOT_A_SEARCH
WISH-1.description: Said where the words searched for are too few or too many to search with.

WISH-10.name: NOT_ITS_SEASON
WISH-10.description: Said where a season named is not one the title has, or seasons were named for a film.

WISH-11.name: NOBODY_ASKING
WISH-11.description: Said where nobody is named for something only a member can do.

WISH-12.name: NOT_A_MEMBER
WISH-12.description: Said where the member named is not somebody in the household.

WISH-13.name: NO_PICTURE
WISH-13.description: Said where a title a member may ask for has no picture to show them.

WISH-2.name: NOT_A_PLACE
WISH-2.description: Said where the place a search was asked to go on from is not one a page answered.

WISH-3.name: NOT_ASKABLE
WISH-3.description: Said where no title this member may ask for goes by the id and kind named.

WISH-4.name: CANNOT_FETCH
WISH-4.description: Said where the house cannot fetch that kind of title, or anything, right now.

WISH-5.name: ALREADY_HERE
WISH-5.description: Said where the title asked for is already in the house.

WISH-6.name: NOTHING_LEFT
WISH-6.description: Said where the member has asked for all their allowance lets them, until it frees up.

WISH-7.name: NO_ROOM
WISH-7.description: Said where the house has no room for new things, which is the house's and nobody's limit.

WISH-8.name: NOT_WORKING
WISH-8.description: Said where what answers the household's asks did not answer, so nothing was asked.

WISH-9.name: NOT_SET_UP
WISH-9.description: Said where the house has nothing to search or ask with at all.
